parameters.help_en: The logon credential. It is issued after an end user successfully logs on through the WUYING client (including the mobile SDK) or the console logon flow, and is used together with SessionId to complete the logon authentication for this operation. The appstream-center 2021-09-03 public API catalog does not provide an operation to obtain or refresh this credential. This parameter applies only to client integration scenarios, and server-side programmatic calls cannot obtain a valid LoginToken
parameters.help_zh:
登录凭证。
终端用户通过无影客户端（含移动端 SDK）或控制台登录流登录成功后签发，与 SessionId 配合使用完成本接口的登录鉴权。appstream-center 2021-09-03 公开 API 目录不提供获取或刷新该凭证的接口，该参数仅适用于客户端集成场景，服务端程序化调用无法获取有效 LoginToken
parameters.name: login_token

parameters.help_en: The logon session ID. It is issued after an end user successfully logs on through the WUYING client (including the mobile SDK) or the console logon flow, and is used together with LoginToken to complete the logon authentication for this operation. The appstream-center 2021-09-03 public API catalog does not provide an operation to obtain this session ID. This parameter applies only to client integration scenarios, and server-side programmatic calls are not supported
parameters.help_zh:
登录会话ID。
终端用户通过无影客户端（含移动端 SDK）或控制台登录流登录成功后签发，与 LoginToken 配合使用完成本接口的登录鉴权。appstream-center 2021-09-03 公开 API 目录不提供获取该会话 ID 的接口，该参数仅适用于客户端集成场景，服务端程序化调用不可行
parameters.name: session_id

parameters.help_en: The tenant ID, which is the Alibaba Cloud account UID. After an end user successfully logs on through the WUYING client (including the mobile SDK) or the console logon flow, you can obtain the ID from the logon result. The ID must be consistent with the tenant to which the LoginToken belongs
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID，即阿里云账号UID。
终端用户通过无影客户端（含移动端 SDK）或控制台登录流登录成功后，可从登录结果中获取，需与 LoginToken 归属的租户保持一致
parameters.name: tenant_id

parameters.help_en: The SessionToken used for authentication. You must choose either the LoginToken and SessionId combination or SessionToken for authentication
parameters.help_zh: 认证使用SessionToken。LoginToken+SessionId与SessionToken两种认证方式必须选择其一
parameters.name: session_token
